i.norm: Verifies that count() correctly counts characters in a string when the CharSet is defined by a sparse set array (only the first element is set; the remaining three elements are null and are ignored by the implementation). The CharSet pattern "!NIzU+h g./^6" matches 12 of the 13 characters in the input string "!NIzU+h g./^6".
A 4-element set array where only index 0 carries the pattern; indices 1-3 remain null and are treated as empty by CharSetUtils.
